title: Green peas, canned, reduced sodium, cooked with butter

content.title: About
content.content: Canned green peas with reduced sodium are cooked in their own juice with added butter or margarine. The product retains a bright color, a delicate flavor and a slightly firm texture, while the lower salt content makes it suitable for sodium‑restricted diets.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Green peas are an excellent source of plant protein and dietary fiber.
Canning preserves most of the B‑vitamins and vitamin C.
Reduced sodium is achieved through specialized processing and limited added salt.
Peas are used in traditional dishes worldwide, from French ragouts to Indian dal.
Cooking with butter enhances the absorption of fat‑soluble vitamins such as vitamin K.

items.title: Rich in plant protein
items.content: One cup of canned peas provides about 8 g of protein, supporting muscle maintenance.

items.title: High in dietary fiber
items.content: Fiber promotes healthy digestion and helps regulate blood sugar levels.

items.title: Source of vitamin K
items.content: Vitamin K is important for blood clotting and bone health.

items.title: Contains iron and folate
items.content: These micronutrients support red blood cell formation and cellular metabolism.

items.title: Low sodium content
items.content: Reduced salt makes the product suitable for people monitoring blood pressure.

items.title: Legume allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to peas.

items.title: Added fat
items.content: Because the peas are cooked with butter, calorie‑conscious consumers should account for the extra fat.

items.title: Preservatives
items.content: Certain batches may contain preservatives that can cause sensitivity in susceptible people.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Peas can be eaten straight from the can, added to salads, soups, stews, or mashed into a puree. They pair well with boiled potatoes, carrots, and meat dishes. For extra flavor, briefly sauté in a pan with a little more butter.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store unopened cans in a cool, dry place. Once opened, keep the peas in an airtight container in the refrigerator and consume within 3–4 days. Discard if an off‑odor or discoloration develops.
